server.name: elesium-sovereign-ai-mcp
server.description: Model Context Protocol specification and client-side tool schema for Elesium. Interactive architecture grading, TCO arbitrage calculation, and compliance tools run client-side at https://elesium.online/tools/. Static GitHub Pages hosting does not serve a live /mcp/sse endpoint.

transport.note: Static GitHub Pages deployment does not host a live SSE daemon at /mcp/sse; execute interactive evaluations via https://elesium.online/tools/.

tools.name: audit_enterprise_architecture
tools.description: Schema for evaluating an enterprise workflow for state graph determinism, infinite loop vulnerability, and statutory compliance (interactive grader at https://elesium.online/tools/agentic-architecture-grader/).

architecture_type.description: Current agentic topology deployed in production

current_latency_ms.description: Observed end-to-end execution latency in milliseconds

compliance_jurisdiction.description: Primary regulatory statutory standard governing data processing

tools.name: calculate_tco_arbitrage
tools.description: Schema for calculating 3-year total cost of ownership (TCO) comparing dedicated private H100 vLLM serving against public API tokens (interactive calculator at https://elesium.online/tools/enterprise-ai-roi-calculator/).

monthly_token_volume_millions.description: Estimated monthly input + output token volume in millions

public_model_baseline.description: Baseline public cloud API model currently utilized

tools.name: verify_statutory_compliance
tools.description: Schema for auditing enterprise data residency and generating a statutory risk profile under DPDP Act 2023, HIPAA, and SEC Rule 17a-4 (interactive tools at https://elesium.online/tools/).

data_residency_model.description: Where model weights and prompt logs are physically processed

tools.name: request_pilot_sprint
tools.description: Schema for enterprise pilot intake sprint with a 14-day production delivery SLA and contractual 90-day ROI guarantee (submit via https://elesium.online/waitlist/ or contact@elesium.online).

enterprise_name.description: Legal name of the enterprise client

contact_email.description: Official corporate email of the technical sponsor

budget_band.description: Allocated commercial sprint budget band (pilot minimum ₹1,50,000 / $2,000)
